scenes.title: Chevening: no upper age limit
scenes.say: Chevening has no upper age limit.

scenes.title: of work experience
scenes.body: At least two years. Compulsory degree work doesn't count.
scenes.say: What it asks for is at least two years of work experience, or two thousand eight hundred hours.

scenes.title: Türkiye Bursları age caps
scenes.say: Türkiye Burslari is different. Bachelor's applicants must be under twenty-one, master's under thirty, and P H D under thirty-five.
